subject: MerchantLane onboarding: preapproval path for short-term pilot
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@merchantlane.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@merchantlane.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MerchantLane onboarding: preapproval path for short-term pilot

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this—we're excited to kick off a short pilot with Redwood. We're a small e-commerce analytics shop and would like to run a 30-day pilot of your hosted inference API for some internal search re-ranking tests. Expected spend for the pilot is around $3,000 total.

Our procurement team prefers to use POs, but given the timeline we'd like to request a temporary invoice-only/preapproval path for this pilot while vendor onboarding completes. Attached: onboarding_form_merchantlane.pdf (filled), commercial_terms.docx (our standard SOW).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) accept invoices without a PO for this pilot under $5k, and 2) what documentation you need to create a temporary vendor record? We'd like to start invoicing as soon as next Monday.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Operations
MerchantLane
elena@merchantlane.com
Attachments: onboarding_form_merchantlane.pdf (pdf form), commercial_terms.docx (docx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@merchantlane.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantLane onboarding: preapproval path for short-term pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and welcome.

Short answer: we can frequently make a temporary invoice-only path for time-boxed pilots, but it requires explicit preapproval and a minimal set of onboarding artifacts. Per our procurement playbook, the typical requirements for a sub-$5k/month pilot are:

- Completed vendor intake form (you've started this — great).
- W9 or equivalent tax documentation.
- Billing contact and invoice recipient.
- Basic security attestation (SOC2 or equivalent) or a short security questionnaire for pilots processing non-sensitive data.

If Lauren and Finance approve, we can provision a temporary vendor record as "Invoice-only (pilot)" and accept invoices without a PO for up to $5k/month for a 90-day window.

Proposed mutual action plan:
- Today (Mon): Confirm billing contact and upload W9 + completed intake form (you already attached the intake).
- Tue: Finance (Lauren) to confirm preapproval and create temporary vendor entry.
- Wed: Redwood sends vendor onboarding confirmation + invoicing address and invoice template.
- Next Mon: MerchantLane sends first invoice.

I've attached our vendor_setup_checklist.pdf to make the process faster. Also putting a DocuSign NDA link here for any contractual addendum: https://docusign.com/merchantlane/123456.

Lauren/Marissa — looping you in to confirm finance coverage and any additional items (insurance, limits, procurement flags).

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com
Attachments: vendor_setup_checklist.pdf

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantLane onboarding: preapproval path for short-term pilot

Connor — thanks for the plan. I'm fine providing conditional approval for a temporary invoice-only pathway under the following conditions (quote):

> "Create temporary vendor record as 'Invoice-only (pilot)'. Approve invoices without PO up to $5k/month for a maximum 90-day period. Required evidence: completed onboarding form, W9, and basic security attestation. If monthly invoices exceed $2k consistently, require certificate of insurance and escalate to procurement for formal PO."

Please ensure MerchantLane uploads the W9 and the completed onboarding_form_merchantlane_filled.pdf (I need the vendor legal name and tax ID in the intake form). Finance will set the vendor status to temporary and will provide the invoicing address and vendor ID once done.

Marissa — please add this to the onboarding tracker and flag if MerchantLane's commercial_terms_redline.docx contains nonstandard payment windows (we typically require net-30 for pilots unless otherwise authorized).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena@merchantlane.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@merchantlane.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantLane onboarding: preapproval path for short-term pilot

Connor / Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Lauren's list, attached are: onboarding_form_merchantlane_filled.pdf (with tax ID), W9_MerchantLane.pdf, and a redline of your SOW (commercial_terms_redline.docx). We confirm billing contact as: invoices@merchantlane.com (AP team).

We've noted the $5k/month cap and 90-day window — that works for us. We'll start with an initial invoice the week after next. If anything else is needed (COI, additional attestations), let me know and procurement@merchantlane.com will follow up.

Appreciate the help — Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Operations, MerchantLane
Attachments: onboarding_form_merchantlane_filled.pdf, W9_MerchantLane.pdf, commercial_terms_redline.docx
